profile.name: Ioana Marin
profile.headline: Content Marketing Specialist
profile.about: I write and run content for B2B software companies: blogs, newsletters and the odd webinar. I care about pieces sales can actually use.
additional_info: Guest lecturer on content strategy at a local marketing course, twice

bullets.text: Run the company blog and publish two articles a week.
bullets.result: organic traffic went from 8,000 to 31,000 visits a month in 18 months

bullets.text: Turned support tickets into how-to guides with the support team.
Organise a quarterly webinar with a customer and a product manager.

notes.text: Sales uses my comparison pages in demos; two of them are linked in the sales playbook
I briefed and edited 4 freelance writers

bullets.text: Wrote destination pages and social posts.
Kept the email list clean and sent the weekly offers email.

job.title: Content Marketing Manager
job.about: We are hiring a Content Marketing Manager to own our content engine: the blog, newsletters, case studies and the content our sales team uses in deals. You will set the editorial calendar, work with product marketing and sales, and report on what content brings pipeline.
job.about_company: Northwind Analytics makes reporting software for mid-size retailers. We are a 120-person scale-up growing in the UK and Germany.
responsibilities: Own the editorial calendar across blog, newsletter and case studies
Grow organic traffic and the newsletter audience
Produce sales enablement content with the sales team
Report on how content contributes to pipeline
